checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same mountains, trees, clouds, lake in original positions
must.why: Layout matches; the pine detail is slightly altered.

must.item: Reflections and surface details retain structure
must.why: Reflection shapes are preserved, but contrast is crushed and detail is lost in the dark areas.

must.item: No sun, sunset or extra elements added
must.why: No new objects, though the sky now reads as a sunset glow.

must.item: Framing, geometry and detail unchanged apart from colour
must.why: The contrast and saturation are heavily boosted, shadows are crushed to near black, and the image has a posterised, over-processed look. This is more than a colour change.

faults.what: The grade is extreme: a sepia/orange cast with crushed blacks and a lost blue sky. It is far more than a gentle warming.
The shadows in the trees and the right-hand foliage are crushed, and detail is lost. The look is posterised with HDR-like artefacts.
Contrast and tone changed beyond colour, and the mood shifted from calm dusk to a dramatic sepia look.

summary: The layout is preserved, but the warming is heavy-handed: a sepia-orange cast with crushed shadows and lost detail, so it changes more than the colour and the user would likely ask for a redo.
